manifest.purpose: Golden vulnerability_report.json matching FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR4. Fields: early_exit_signal='mismatch_found (and done asserted early via the `if (expected_byte != received_byte) begin mismatch_found<=1; done<=1; match<=0; end` branch inside the `running && !done` block, gated by byte_valid) in signature_compare.v' identifying the exact RTL construct causing early termination on first differing byte pair. cycle_relationship states the derived formula from RTL semantics: start pulse consumed cycle 0; byte i is presented/sampled the cycle after start plus i cycles; mismatch detected on the byte_valid cycle for position k asserts done on that same clock edge (registered), so cycles_to_done (measured as in testbench_harness.v, counting from the cycle after start) = k+2 for mismatch at 0-indexed position k (k=0 -> 2, k=15 -> 17); full match (byte_count reaches 15 with equality) also asserts done on the 16th consumed byte, giving cycles_to_done = 18 for full match (since byte_count increments only on non-terminal equal bytes, terminal check at count==15 fires on the 16th byte). Exact integer values must be consistent with testbench cycle-counting convention (cycle_count incremented once per @(posedge clk) while streaming). baseline_behavior.full_match_verdict='match', mismatch_at_zero_verdict='mismatch'. constant_time_fix describes: remove the early `done<=1` branch on mismatch; instead every cycle while running, consume the byte pair unconditionally (ignore mismatch_found for early termination), OR the per-byte inequality into a sticky mismatch_found register every cycle, increment byte_count every valid byte regardless of match/mismatch, and assert done only when byte_count reaches 15 (i.e., after all 16 bytes consumed), setting match = !mismatch_found at that point. proposed_fix_preserves_correctness=true. This file must not claim baseline is already constant-time (violates SR4).
